title: Disconnection Notices and the New Agreement Security Deposit Plan
content:
Disconnection notices shorten the installment plan of a Security Deposit on a new agreement.

**Clause.** Two or more disconnection notices issued on any of the customer's Electric Service Agreements in the 12 months ending on the payment date take 2 installments off the plan; exactly one takes 1 off; none takes nothing off.

| Disconnection notices on any of the customer's agreements in the 12 months | Installments taken off |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 2 |
| Exactly one | 1 |
| None | Nothing |

Each notice on record, written or final, counts as one, and notices on every agreement of the customer are counted together.

## Cases (hypothetical notice histories)

- One written notice on the customer's old agreement 7 months before the payment date and one final notice on another agreement 2 months before: two notices, 2 installments off.
- One written notice 9 months before the payment date: 1 installment off.
- One written notice 14 months before the payment date: outside the 12 months, nothing off.
